newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Natural Gas Q3 loss shrinks.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Natural Gas Q3 loss shrinks.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - First Call mean estimate for Q3 was a loss of $0.03 per share.

Figures for 1995 nine months include write-down of the cost of gas and oil producing properties amounting to $145 million, or $1.56 a share; special charges related to workforce reductions amounting to $26 million, or $0.27 per share; and write-down to adjust the cost of coal properties amounting to $20.3 million, or $0.22 per share. Without these items, net income would have been $125.2 million, or $1.34 a share.
1995 Q3 includes special charges related to workforce reductions amounting to $2.3 million, or $0.02 per share. Without this item, net loss would have been $8.9 million, or $0.10 a share.
Full company name is Consolidated Natural Gas Co.
